records.Solution__c:
Telecommunication & IT ICP
 

Software, SaaS, AI, and platform companies needing external market validation and adoption patterns — the software-centric segment of the Telecommunication & IT vertical.


 

Telecommunication & IT ICP — Identification Signals
- Strong product/engineering presence
- Mentions of AI, platforms, APIs in their positioning
- Multi-vertical GTM model (selling to multiple industries)
- Venture-backed or growth-stage
- Data-driven culture and decision making


Telecommunication & IT ICP — Key Pains

 - Fragmented research - Market data scattered across too many sources; no single trusted external layer
 - Slow stakeholder turnaround - Ad hoc internal requests take too long to answer with credible data
 - Weak external benchmarks - Strong internal metrics but limited market perspective to validate against
 - No clean forecast source - Difficulty finding forward-looking data for market sizing and GTM planning
 - Cross-market comparability - Operating across countries but data formats and sources are inconsistent
 - Validating strategic assumptions - Board decks and investor materials need defensible third-party evidence
 - Limited view beyond own customers - Internal data strong, but blind to market-level consumer behaviour

 

Telecommunication & IT ICP— Why Statista Fits
- External market sizing and forecasts for investor decks and strategy
- Consumer/industry adoption trends for product roadmap
- API integration into internal tools, copilots, and dashboards
- Cross-vertical coverage for multi-industry GTM
- External data layer for BI and product teams — complements internal analytics and CRM without replacing them
 

Telecommunication & IT ICP — Product Relevance
- Platform (Primary fit): general research, quick facts
- Market Insights (Primary fit): market sizing, TAM validation
- Consumer Insights (Secondary fit): consumer apps, B2C tech
- eCommerce Insights (Secondary fit): Online store benchmarking, marketplace performance (e-commerce sub-segment)
- AskStatista (Secondary fit): On-demand analyst support for niche or harder-to-locate data pulls
- Connect/API (High potential fit): AI copilots, data platforms
 

Telecommunication & IT ICP — Target Personas
 - Strategy / BizOps - Planning, investor materials, market sizing
 - Market Intelligence - Competitive analysis, market sizing, external benchmarks
 - Product Lead (CPO, VP Product) - Roadmap context, market validation, feature opportunity sizing
 - Marketing Lead (CMO, VP Marketing, Regional Marketing) - Audience insight, cross-market differences, campaign planning
 - Head of Data / AI - External benchmark layer, API and workflow integration, data platform enrichment
 - Consultant / Sales / Advisory - Third-party proof points, pitch support, faster proposal creation
 

Telecommunication & IT ICP — Sub-Segments
- Software & SaaS: TAM validation, market sizing, competitive benchmarks
- Internet Platforms: User behaviour, category trends, multi-market comparisons
- Payments & Fintech: Regulatory context, market sizing, adoption trends
- E-commerce & Marketplaces: Online retail benchmarks, category performance, consumer behaviour
- Digital Infrastructure & Connectivity: Capacity trends, investment data, policy context
- Consumer Electronics: Device market trends, adoption curves, regional demand
- Media, Streaming & Gaming: Audience data, content consumption trends, ad market sizing
- Telecoms: Subscriber trends, market share, network investment data

 

Telecommunication & IT ICP — Company Stage
- Early-stage (Seed-A): TAM validation, pitch deck support. Product focus: Platform.
- Growth (B-C): Market expansion, competitive intel. Product focus: Platform + Market Insights.
- Scale (D+, Pre-IPO): Governance, integration, multi-team. Product focus: Connect + Full suite.
 

Telecommunication & IT ICP — Competitive Landscape
Tech companies often use internal analytics (Amplitude, Mixpanel), industry analysts (Gartner, Forrester for enterprise tech), competitive intelligence tools (Crayon, Klue) and Ad-hoc research and surveys. Statista's angle is breadth of external market data + API for integration. Complements internal analytics with external context.
 

Telecommunication & IT ICP — Expansion Signals
- Funding announcement
- Hiring for strategy, market intelligence, or data roles
- International expansion
- New product launches or vertical entries
- AI/ML initiatives
 

Telecommunication & IT ICP — Summary
The Telecommunication & IT ICP covers software, SaaS, AI, internet platforms, fintech, e-commerce, digital infrastructure, consumer electronics, and media and streaming companies. These companies have strong internal data but lack external market context. Core pains are fragmented research, slow stakeholder turnaround, weak external benchmarks, and difficulty validating strategic assumptions with third-party evidence. Statista fits as an external data layer that complements internal analytics without replacing them. Primary products are Platform and Market Insights; Connect is high-potential for data and engineering teams; eCommerce Insights and AskStatista are relevant for e-commerce sub-segments and niche data needs. Target personas are Strategy, Market Intelligence, Product, Marketing, Data/AI, and Consulting/Sales leads.
